an8.9:1.1: kulaputtoti bhikkhave nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.9:1.2: balavāti bhikkhave nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.9:1.3: pāsādikoti bhikkhave nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.9:1.4: tibbarāgoti bhikkhave nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.9:1.5: kimaññattha bhikkhave nando indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyamanuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato yehi nando sakkoti paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
an8.9:1.6: tatridaṃ bhikkhave nandassa indriyesu guttadvāratāya hoti
an8.9:1.7: sace bhikkhave nandassa puratthimā disā āloketabbā hoti sabbañcetaso samannāharitvā nando puratthimaṃ disaṃ āloketi
an8.9:1.8: evaṃ me puratthimaṃ disaṃ ālokayato nābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti
an8.9:2.1: sace bhikkhave nandassa pacchimā disā āloketabbā hoti
an8.9:2.6: anudisā anuviloketabbā hoti sabbañcetaso samannāharitvā nando anudisaṃ anuviloketi
an8.9:2.7: evaṃ me anudisaṃ anuvilokayato nābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti
an8.9:2.9: idaṃ kho bhikkhave nandassa indriyesu guttadvāratāya hoti.
an8.9:3.1: tatridaṃ bhikkhave nandassa bhojane mattaññutāya hoti
an8.9:3.2: idha bhikkhave nando paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
an8.9:3.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva deva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti
an8.9:3.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave nandassa bhojane mattaññutāya hoti.
an8.9:4.2: idha bhikkhave nando divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
an8.9:4.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
an8.9:4.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā
an8.9:4.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti
an8.9:4.6: idaṃ kho bhikkhave nandassa jāgariyānuyogasmiṃ hoti.
an8.9:5.2: idha bhikkhave nandassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti
an8.9:5.3: viditā saññā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti
an8.9:5.4: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti viditā upaṭṭhahanti viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti
an8.9:5.5: idaṃ kho bhikkhave nandassa satisampajaññasmiṃ hotīti.
an8.9:6.1: kimaññattha bhikkhave nando indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyamanuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato yehi nando sakkoti paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritunti. 10
